query:
SELECT week_start AS period, channel AS segment, 100.0 * SUM(margin) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) AS value
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
summary: 1 unusual run(s) for margin_pct by channel, period 2025-Q2: Online 2025-06-02 to 2025-06-23 high (peak 56.9% vs ~41.5% expected). No sales at all for: Reseller 2025-04-07, Reseller 2025-04-14, Reseller 2025-04-21, Reseller 2025-05-05, Reseller 2025-05-12, Reseller 2025-05-19, Reseller 2025-05-26, Reseller 2025-06-02
